summary: @or-sdk/library-types-v1 executes obfuscated payload via Bun runtime at install time
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling script math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB obfuscated bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing string-array rotation and a large opcode/literal table — the standard opaque loader shape. Executing an alternate JavaScript runtime specifically to run a heavily obfuscated bundle on every `npm install` does not match the package's advertised purpose of generating TypeScript types, and routing execution through Bun evades Node-focused install-time inspection. The obfuscated payload's behavior cannot be validated, and the execution path is unconditional under the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
